m: The **highest** **people's** court that **checks** and **examines**: the **Supreme People's Procuratorate**.
ex: 最高人民检察院在北京。
The Supreme People's Procuratorate is in Beijing.
最高人民检察院负责全国的检察工作。
The Supreme People's Procuratorate is in charge of prosecution work nationwide.
use: China's top prosecuting body; shortened to 最高检.

ex: 随州在湖北省北部。
Suizhou is in northern Hubei.
很多人去随州看古代的编钟。
Many people go to Suizhou to see the ancient bronze bells.
use: Prefecture-level city; famous for the Marquis Yi of Zeng bells.

m: A **topic** given its own **special** treatment: a **special topic** or feature.
ex: 这期杂志有一个旅游专题。
This issue of the magazine has a travel feature.
电视台做了一个关于环保的专题节目。
The TV station made a special programme on environmental protection.
use: 专题讲座 "lecture on a set topic"; 专题报道 "special report".

m: What is **different** and sets things **apart**: a **difference**.
ex: 这两个词有什么差别？
What's the difference between these two words?
城市和农村的生活差别很大。
Life in the city and the countryside differs greatly.
use: Pattern A和B的差别; close to 区别 and 差异.

ex: 这家工厂是外资企业。
This factory is a foreign-funded company.
这几年，越来越多的外资进入了中国。
In recent years more and more foreign capital has come into China.
use: 引进外资 "attract foreign investment".

m: A **thousand** times **ten thousand**: **ten million**, and as an adverb, **be sure to**.
ex: 你千万别忘了！
Whatever you do, don't forget!
这座城市有一千万人口。
This city has a population of ten million.
use: As an adverb it is a strong warning, often with 别 or 不要.

ex: 你有没有中文词典？
Do you have a Chinese dictionary?
你昨天有没有去上课？
Did you go to class yesterday?
use: Makes a yes-no question without 吗; 有没有 + verb asks about a past action.

ex: 公民应该依法纳税。
Citizens should pay tax according to law.
警察依法处理了这起交通事故。
The police dealt with the traffic accident according to law.
use: Formal; before a verb: 依法办事, 依法处理.

m: A **point** on the **earth**: a **place** or site.
ex: 开会的地点在哪儿？
Where is the meeting being held?
请告诉我见面的时间和地点。
Please tell me the time and place to meet.
use: Often paired with 时间: 时间和地点.

ex: 这座桥以他的名字命名。
This bridge is named after him.
科学家给新发现的星星命名了。
The scientists named the newly found star.
use: 以…命名 "be named after…".

ex: 这里简直太美了！
It's simply beautiful here!
他做的菜简直跟饭店里的一样好吃。
The food he makes is just as tasty as a restaurant's.
use: Spoken, for exaggeration: 简直不敢相信 "can hardly believe it".

ex: 这座寺庙始建于唐代。
This temple was first built in the Tang dynasty.
这所学校始建于一九二零年。
This school was founded in 1920.
use: Written, almost always 始建于 + time.

ex: 大人都搬不动，何况孩子呢？
Even adults can't move it, let alone a child.
这么简单的问题他都不会，何况难的呢。
He can't even do such an easy question, let alone hard ones.
use: Often after 都 or 连…都…, ending with 呢.

m: **Compassion** and **joy**: **Cixi**, the Empress Dowager of the late Qing.
ex: 慈禧太后住在颐和园。
Empress Dowager Cixi lived in the Summer Palace.
慈禧控制清朝政府将近五十年。
Cixi controlled the Qing government for nearly fifty years.
use: Usually 慈禧太后 "Empress Dowager Cixi".

ex: 我们家只买有机蔬菜。
We only buy organic vegetables at home.
这几个部分是一个有机的整体。
These parts form an organic whole.
use: 有机食品 "organic food"; 有机化学 "organic chemistry".

ex: 今天天气较为凉快。
Today is relatively cool.
这个方法较为简单，大家都能学会。
This method is fairly simple; everyone can learn it.
use: Written; in speech use 比较.

m: Under the **quilt**, then **forced** out: to be **forced** to.
ex: 因为下雨，比赛被迫取消了。
Because of the rain, the match had to be cancelled.
他被迫离开了自己的家乡。
He was forced to leave his hometown.
use: Followed by a verb: 被迫离开, 被迫停止.

ex: 我喜欢晚上读书。
I like reading at night.
他还在大学读书，明年毕业。
He's still studying at university and graduates next year.
use: Also means "be at school": 在北京读书.

ex: 香港是一个特别行政区。
Hong Kong is a special administrative region.
这个城市分成十个行政区。
This city is divided into ten administrative districts.
use: 特别行政区 "Special Administrative Region".

ex: 他有点儿悲观的倾向。
He tends to be a bit pessimistic.
我倾向于明天再做决定。
I'm inclined to decide tomorrow.
use: 倾向于 + verb "be inclined to".

m: The **earth** a country holds by the **neck**: **territory**.
ex: 这个岛是我国的领土。
This island is our country's territory.
每个国家都要保护自己的领土。
Every country must protect its own territory.
use: Political; 领土完整 "territorial integrity".

ex: 每个人都有权受教育。
Everyone has the right to education.
顾客有权知道商品的价格。
Customers have the right to know the price of goods.
use: Followed by a verb: 有权决定, 有权知道.

ex: 你会说英文吗？
Can you speak English?
这本书有中文版，也有英文版。
This book has a Chinese edition and an English edition.
use: Same as 英语; 英文 leans to the written language.

ex: 我们队战胜了对手。
Our team beat the opponents.
她战胜了疾病，又回到了工作岗位。
She beat her illness and went back to work.
use: Also figurative: 战胜困难 "overcome difficulties".

ex: 这个词的使用频率很高。
This word is used very often.
你每周运动的频率是多少？
How often do you exercise each week?
use: Also the physics term for radio frequency.

m: How things are **laid out** in each **section**: the **layout**.
ex: 这套房子的布局很合理。
The layout of this flat is very sensible.
这座城市的布局是方方正正的。
The city has a neat, square layout.
use: For rooms, cities and plans; also a verb "lay out".

ex: 感冒是病毒引起的。
Colds are caused by viruses.
我的电脑中了病毒，打不开了。
My computer got a virus and won't open.
use: Both for illness and computers: 电脑病毒.

m: **Passed** along until it **comes**: to **come through**, be heard.
ex: 远处传来了音乐声。
Music came from far away.
从北京传来了好消息。
Good news came from Beijing.
use: Often 传来…声 or 传来消息.

ex: 电脑可以自动生成报告。
The computer can generate reports automatically.
这种化学反应会生成新的物质。
This chemical reaction produces a new substance.
use: Technical; common in computing: 自动生成.

ex: 我喜欢黑色的衣服。
I like black clothes.
他开着一辆黑色的车来接我。
He came to pick me up in a black car.
use: Before nouns use 黑色的; 黑 alone also works: 黑头发.

ex: 他的言语很有礼貌。
He speaks very politely.
有时候言语也能伤害别人。
Sometimes words can hurt people too.
use: Written; also yán yu as a spoken verb "say something" in the north.

ex: 这个国家向外输出石油。
This country exports oil.
电脑把结果输出到屏幕上。
The computer outputs the result to the screen.
use: Opposite 输入 "input".

ex: 民国时期有很多军阀。
There were many warlords in the Republican era.
这些军阀为了地盘互相打仗。
These warlords fought each other for territory.
use: Historical; especially 1916–1928 in China.

ex: 天一下子黑了。
The sky suddenly went dark.
他一下子就把问题解决了。
He solved the problem in one go.
use: Spoken; stresses suddenness or speed.

ex: 荷兰有很多风车。
The Netherlands has lots of windmills.
我的朋友在荷兰学习花卉种植。
My friend is studying flower growing in the Netherlands.
use: 荷兰人 "Dutch person"; 荷兰语 "Dutch".

m: **How**, in what **manner**: **how about**? how is it?
ex: 你最近怎么样？
How have you been lately?
我们明天去看电影，怎么样？
Let's go see a film tomorrow, how about it?
use: Ends a suggestion or asks for an opinion; 不怎么样 "not great".

ex: 黄石市在长江边上。
Huangshi is on the Yangtze River.
黄石市以前是有名的工业城市。
Huangshi used to be a well-known industrial city.
use: Prefecture-level city in eastern Hubei, known for mining.

m: **Luo** River and **sunny side**: **Luoyang**, a city in Henan.
ex: 洛阳是一座古都。
Luoyang is an ancient capital.
每年四月，很多人去洛阳看牡丹花。
Every April, many people go to Luoyang to see the peonies.
use: Named for being north (the sunny side) of the Luo River.

m: **Think** of an **elephant** you have never seen: to **imagine**.
ex: 我无法想象没有手机的生活。
I can't imagine life without a phone.
孩子们的想象力非常丰富。
Children have very rich imaginations.
use: 想象力 "imagination"; also written 想像.

ex: 包括我在内，一共五个人。
Including me, there are five people in all.
房费包括早餐在内。
The room rate includes breakfast.
use: Pattern 包括…在内 "including…".

ex: 火车就要开了。
The train is about to leave.
我们就要放假了，大家都很高兴。
We're about to go on holiday; everyone is happy.
use: Pattern 就要…了 "be about to".

m: A **special** thing a place **produces**: a **local specialty**.
ex: 这是我们家乡的特产。
This is a specialty of our hometown.
旅游的时候，我喜欢买一些当地特产。
When I travel, I like to buy some local specialties.
use: Often brought home as gifts.

ex: 陛下，大臣们都到了。
Your Majesty, the ministers have all arrived.
电视剧里的大臣常说“陛下万岁”。
Ministers in TV dramas often say "Long live Your Majesty".
use: Only for monarchs; found in historical dramas.

m: By one's **self** it **goes**: **by oneself**, on one's own.
ex: 请大家自行回家。
Please make your own way home.
这个问题需要你们自行解决。
You'll need to solve this problem yourselves.
use: Formal, before a verb; 自行车 is "bicycle".

ex: 这个工程的周期是两年。
This project has a two-year cycle.
月亮变化的周期大约是一个月。
The moon's cycle is about a month.
use: Used in science and business: 生产周期.

ex: 科学技术改变了我们的生活。
Science and technology have changed our lives.
科学技术是第一生产力。
Science and technology are the primary productive force.
use: Usually shortened to 科技.

ex: 他爸爸是一名军官。
His father is an army officer.
那位年轻军官向大家敬了个礼。
The young officer saluted everyone.
use: Opposite: 士兵 "soldier".

ex: 他每天在实验室工作。
He works in the lab every day.
实验室里有很多新的仪器。
The laboratory has lots of new instruments.
use: Measure word 个 or 间.

m: A **position** on watch, as on a **hillock**: a **post** or job.
ex: 每个人都要做好自己岗位上的工作。
Everyone should do their own job well.
她在这个岗位上工作了二十年。
She has worked in this post for twenty years.
use: Formal; often 工作岗位.

ex: 城乡差别越来越小了。
The gap between city and countryside is getting smaller.
政府正在努力改善城乡交通。
The government is working to improve urban and rural transport.
use: Used in policy talk: 城乡发展.

m: **Take care of** **matters**: to **handle affairs**, do things.
ex: 我去银行办事。
I'm going to the bank to sort something out.
他办事很认真，大家都信任他。
He handles things carefully; everyone trusts him.
use: 办事处 "office, agency".

ex: 他沉默了很久才回答。
He was silent for a long time before he answered.
她是一个沉默的人，不太爱说话。
She is a quiet person who doesn't talk much.
use: 保持沉默 "keep silent".

ex: 他退出了比赛。
He withdrew from the competition.
用完电脑以后，记得退出账号。
After using the computer, remember to log out of your account.
use: Also "log out" or "exit" in apps.

ex: 宇宙到底有多大？
How big is the universe?
他从小就对宇宙和星星很感兴趣。
He has been interested in the universe and stars since he was little.
use: 宇宙飞船 "spaceship".

ex: 这件事要去法院解决。
This has to be settled in court.
法院明天会宣布判决结果。
The court will announce its verdict tomorrow.
use: Measure word 个 or 家.

ex: 今天的空气质量指数很高。
Today's air quality index is high.
股票指数今天上涨了百分之二。
The stock index rose two percent today.
use: Also the maths term "exponent".

m: **Right** in the **middle**: **among**, in the middle of.
ex: 我们当中谁最高？
Who among us is the tallest?
在这些书当中，我最喜欢这一本。
Of all these books, I like this one best.
use: After a noun: 学生当中 "among the students".

ex: 他们分离了二十年才重新见面。
They were apart for twenty years before meeting again.
这台机器可以把油和水分离开。
This machine can separate oil from water.
use: For people parting and for things being separated.

ex: 皇帝下了一道诏书。
The emperor issued an edict.
大臣跪下来听太监读诏书。
The minister knelt to hear the eunuch read the edict.
use: Measure word 道. Historical.

ex: 我想和你单独谈谈。
I'd like to talk with you alone.
这个孩子还太小，不能单独出门。
This child is still too young to go out alone.
use: Before a verb: 单独住, 单独行动.

ex: 马克思提出了剩余价值理论。
Marx put forward the theory of surplus value.
老师在课上讲了什么是剩余价值。
The teacher explained in class what surplus value is.
use: Marxist economics term.

ex: 水分子由氢原子和氧原子组成。
A water molecule is made of hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
原子非常小，用眼睛是看不见的。
Atoms are very small; you can't see them with your eyes.
use: 原子弹 "atom bomb"; 原子能 "atomic energy".

ex: 他对我如同亲兄弟一样。
He treats me like his own brother.
时间如同流水，一去不回。
Time is like flowing water; once gone it never returns.
use: Written; in speech use 像 or 好像.

m: A **person** who does **work** here: a **staff member**.
ex: 请问工作人员在哪儿？
Excuse me, where are the staff?
有问题可以找工作人员帮忙。
If you have a problem, ask a staff member for help.
use: Measure word 名 or 位.

ex: 运动可以消除疲劳。
Exercise can get rid of tiredness.
我们需要好好谈谈，消除误会。
We need to talk properly and clear up the misunderstanding.
use: Used with 误会, 影响, 疲劳.

m: Up on a **horse**, **up** and off: **at once**, right away.
ex: 我马上就来。
I'll be right there.
电影马上就要开始了，快进去吧。
The film is about to start; let's go in.
use: Spoken and very common; often with 就.

m: A **thin piece** that **shines** with a picture: a **photo**.
ex: 这是我小时候的照片。
This is a photo of me as a child.
我们在长城上照了很多照片。
We took lots of photos on the Great Wall.
use: Measure word 张. 照/拍照片 "take photos".

ex: 红灯意味着停车。
A red light means stop.
长大意味着要承担更多责任。
Growing up means taking on more responsibility.
use: Takes a phrase or clause as its object.

m: **Receive** and **wait on**: to **host** or receive guests.
ex: 今天我们要接待一位重要客人。
Today we're hosting an important guest.
这家酒店每年接待很多外国游客。
This hotel receives many foreign tourists every year.
use: 接待处 "reception desk".

ex: 家庭是社会的组成部分。
The family is a part of society.
这本书是中国文化的重要组成部分。
This book is an important part of Chinese culture.
use: Formal; often 重要组成部分.

ex: 我胸口有点儿疼。
My chest hurts a bit.
他把手放在胸口，深深地吸了一口气。
He put his hand on his chest and took a deep breath.
use: The front of the chest; 胸 alone is broader.

ex: 他在民政局工作。
He works at the civil affairs bureau.
结婚登记要去民政部门办理。
You register a marriage at the civil affairs office.
use: 民政局 handles marriages, welfare and the like.

m: The **sacrifice** of a **beast**: to **sacrifice**, to die for a cause.
ex: 他在战争中牺牲了。
He died in the war.
为了孩子，她牺牲了很多休息时间。
For her child, she gave up a lot of rest time.
use: Respectful way to say someone died for a cause.

ex: 大家选出了新班长。
Everyone elected a new class monitor.
请从这些照片中选出你最喜欢的一张。
Please pick your favourite from these photos.
use: Result verb: 选出来 is also common.

ex: 我婆婆对我很好。
My mother-in-law is very good to me.
她每个周末都去看望婆婆。
She visits her mother-in-law every weekend.
use: Only the husband's mother; the wife's mother is 岳母 or 丈母娘.

m: A **warehouse** of **writing**: a **library** or collection of works.
ex: 这套文库收了很多名著。
This collection includes many classics.
我在网上文库找到了这份资料。
I found this document in an online library.
use: Often the name of book series or document sites.

ex: 我身后站着一个人。
Someone was standing behind me.
他走在前面，小狗跟在他身后。
He walked in front, with the puppy following behind him.
use: Also "after one's death": 身后事.

m: **Spread** things and **install** them: to **arrange**, set up.
ex: 我们一起布置房间吧。
Let's decorate the room together.
老师布置了很多作业。
The teacher set a lot of homework.
use: 布置作业 "assign homework"; 布置会场 "set up a venue".

m: **One** whole **body**: from **head to toe**, all over.
ex: 他出了一身汗。
He was covered in sweat.
她今天穿了一身白衣服，很漂亮。
She was dressed all in white today, and looked lovely.
use: Also a measure for a suit of clothes: 一身西装.

ex: 这个条件对我们很有利。
This condition is very favourable to us.
多吃水果有利于身体健康。
Eating more fruit is good for your health.
use: Patterns 对…有利 and 有利于….

ex: 我们要尊重他人。
We should respect others.
不要把自己的想法强加给他人。
Don't force your ideas on other people.
use: Formal; in speech use 别人.

ex: 请描述一下那个人的样子。
Please describe what that person looked like.
他对这座城市的描述非常生动。
His description of the city is very vivid.
use: More formal than 说; close to 描写.

ex: 他在学习，与此同时，他也在打工。
He's studying, and at the same time working part-time.
经济发展了，与此同时，环境问题也出现了。
The economy grew; at the same time, environmental problems appeared.
use: Written; links two sentences.

ex: 把两种颜色混合在一起。
Mix the two colours together.
这种饮料是水果和牛奶混合做成的。
This drink is made by blending fruit and milk.
use: 混合物 "mixture"; 混合动力 "hybrid power".

ex: 原有的计划改变了。
The original plan changed.
学校在原有的基础上又盖了一座楼。
The school added another building to what it already had.
use: Formal; before a noun with 的.

ex: 听到这个消息，他顿时哭了。
He burst into tears the moment he heard the news.
老师一进来，教室里顿时安静了。
As soon as the teacher came in, the classroom went quiet.
use: Written, for past events; 马上 is for the future.

m: **Feel** something **dye** you: to **infect**, also to move someone.
ex: 伤口感染了。
The wound has become infected.
她的笑声感染了大家。
Her laughter was infectious to everyone.
use: Both for illness and for feelings spreading.

ex: 语言是我们最大的障碍。
Language is our biggest obstacle.
他克服了很多障碍，终于成功了。
He overcame many obstacles and finally succeeded.
use: Also medical: 语言障碍 "speech disorder".

m: The **spirit** and **colour** of a face: a person's **look** or expression.
ex: 他神色紧张地走了进来。
He came in looking nervous.
看她的神色，好像有什么心事。
From her expression, she seems to have something on her mind.
use: Written; close to 表情 and 脸色.

ex: 两国签署了合作协议。
The two countries signed a cooperation agreement.
总统明天会签署这项法律。
The president will sign this law tomorrow.
use: Formal, for agreements and laws; 签字/签名 is everyday "sign".

ex: 基督教是世界三大宗教之一。
Christianity is one of the world's three major religions.
她家里人都信基督教。
Everyone in her family is Christian.
use: 基督教徒 "a Christian"; 基督 "Christ".

ex: 快收拾一下你的房间！
Go tidy your room!
我们正在收拾行李，明天出发。
We're packing our bags; we leave tomorrow.
use: Spoken; also slang for "deal with, punish" someone.

ex: 我在酒店大厅等你。
I'll wait for you in the hotel lobby.
机场大厅里有很多人在排队。
Lots of people are queueing in the airport hall.
use: Measure word 个. For lobbies, concourses and halls.

ex: 这家公司占有很大的市场。
This company holds a large market share.
他想一个人占有所有的东西。
He wants to keep everything for himself.
use: Formal; 占有重要地位 "hold an important position".

ex: 政府加大了对教育的投入。
The government increased its investment in education.
风越来越大，雨也加大了。
The wind got stronger and the rain got heavier.
use: With 力度, 投入, 难度.

ex: 对不起，我不是故意的。
Sorry, I didn't mean to.
他故意把声音放得很低。
He deliberately kept his voice very low.
use: 不是故意的 "not on purpose" is very common.

m: Come **down** from your **post**: to be **laid off**.
ex: 他的妈妈前几年下岗了。
His mother was laid off a few years ago.
很多下岗工人开了自己的小店。
Many laid-off workers opened their own small shops.
use: Especially for state-company layoffs in the 1990s; originally "go off duty".

ex: 李白是唐代的诗人。
Li Bai was a Tang dynasty poet.
唐代的长安是世界上最大的城市之一。
Tang dynasty Chang'an was one of the largest cities in the world.
use: Same as 唐朝.

m: A **courtyard**, the open space inside a home.
ex: 孩子们在院子里玩。
The children are playing in the yard.
奶奶在院子里种了很多花。
Grandma has planted lots of flowers in the courtyard.
use: Measure word 个.

ex: 这里属于亚热带气候。
This area has a subtropical climate.
亚热带地区冬天不太冷，夏天很热。
Subtropical regions have mild winters and hot summers.
use: Compare 热带 "tropics", 温带 "temperate zone".

ex: 这张照片是电脑合成的。
This photo was made by computer.
科学家用简单的物质合成了新材料。
Scientists synthesised a new material from simple substances.
use: 合成纤维 "synthetic fibre".

ex: 我的脑袋有点儿疼。
My head hurts a bit.
他摸了摸孩子的脑袋，笑了。
He patted the child's head and smiled.
use: Spoken; 头 is the neutral word. Also "brains": 脑袋好.

ex: 今天我代替王老师上课。
Today I'm taking Mr Wang's class for him.
电脑不能完全代替人的工作。
Computers cannot fully replace human work.
use: Pattern A代替B "A replaces B".

ex: 五一我们去旅游吧。
Let's go travelling over May Day.
五一假期，景点的人特别多。
Tourist sites are very crowded during the May Day holiday.
use: Short for 五一劳动节 "Labour Day".

ex: 历代皇帝都住在这里。
Emperors of every dynasty lived here.
这座山上有很多历代名人写的字。
This mountain has writing by famous people of many dynasties.
use: Written; often 中国历代.

ex: 这是一个常用的词。
This is a commonly used word.
这些常用汉字你都要会写。
You need to be able to write all these common characters.
use: 常用词 "common words"; 常用语 "everyday phrases".

ex: 我的钥匙不见了。
My keys have gone missing.
好久不见，你还好吗？
Long time no see, how are you?
use: 不见了 "has vanished"; 不见不散 "be there or be square".

m: **Arrange** the **names** in order: to **rank**, a ranking.
ex: 他在比赛中排名第三。
He came third in the competition.
这所大学的排名每年都在提高。
This university's ranking rises every year.
use: 排名第一 "rank first"; 排名前十 "top ten".

m: A **diary** for the **eye** to scan: a **table of contents**, catalogue.
ex: 请先看一下书的目录。
First have a look at the book's table of contents.
商店的产品目录上有价格。
The shop's product catalogue has the prices.
use: Also a computer "directory".

ex: 很多人在广场上示威。
Many people are demonstrating in the square.
工人们举行示威，要求提高工资。
The workers held a demonstration demanding higher pay.
use: 示威游行 "protest march".

ex: 他向服务员询问洗手间在哪儿。
He asked the waiter where the toilet was.
有问题可以打电话询问。
If you have questions, you can call and ask.
use: Formal; 问 is the everyday word.

m: Characters for the sound: **London**, a city name.
ex: 伦敦是英国的首都。
London is the capital of the UK.
伦敦经常下雨，出门要带伞。
It often rains in London, so take an umbrella.
use: 伦敦人 "Londoner".

m: A **chief** who is **old**: an **elder**, a senior monk.
ex: 村里的长老说话很有分量。
The village elders' words carry great weight.
寺里的长老已经八十多岁了。
The senior monk at the temple is over eighty.
use: Also used for church elders and senior monks.

m: Those who share the **same** **matters** at work: a **colleague**.
ex: 他是我的同事。
He's my colleague.
下班以后，我常和同事一起吃饭。
After work I often eat with my colleagues.
use: Measure word 个 or 位.

ex: 你现在去哪儿？
Where are you going now?
我的手机不知道放到哪儿去了。
I don't know where I've put my phone.
use: Northern and spoken; 哪里 is the same.

ex: 大城市的住房很贵。
Housing is expensive in big cities.
政府正在帮助年轻人解决住房问题。
The government is helping young people with housing.
use: Formal; 房子 is the everyday word.

ex: 我们学校的球队赢了。
Our school team won.
他从小就想加入国家足球队。
He has wanted to join the national football team since childhood.
use: Measure word 支.

ex: 老师把我们分成三组。
The teacher divided us into three groups.
这个蛋糕可以分成八块。
This cake can be cut into eight pieces.
use: Pattern 把A分成B. As fēnchéng it can also mean "a share of profits".

ex: 我只吃了半个苹果。
I only ate half an apple.
他等了半个小时，朋友才到。
He waited half an hour before his friend arrived.
use: Followed by a noun: 半个月 "half a month".

m: **Resist** going the **contrary** way: to **resist** or rebel.
ex: 人民起来反抗压迫。
The people rose up against oppression.
孩子长大了，开始反抗父母的安排。
As children grow up, they start to resist their parents' plans.
use: Stronger than 反对 "oppose".

ex: 那是一个反动政府。
That was a reactionary government.
老电影里常常有反动派的角色。
Old films often have reactionary villains.
use: Political and historical; 反动派 "reactionaries".

ex: 我们通过旅行社订了机票。
We booked our flights through a travel agency.
这家旅行社组织的旅游团很受欢迎。
The tour groups run by this agency are very popular.
use: Measure word 家.

ex: 太阳能是一种干净的能源。
Solar power is a clean energy source.
我们要节约能源，保护环境。
We should save energy and protect the environment.
use: 新能源 "new energy"; 能源危机 "energy crisis".

ex: 这篇文章批判了社会上的不良现象。
This article criticises bad social practices.
我们要用批判的眼光看问题。
We should look at problems with a critical eye.
use: Stronger and more formal than 批评.

ex: 昨日下了一场大雨。
There was a heavy rain yesterday.
昨日的会议讨论了明年的计划。
Yesterday's meeting discussed next year's plans.
use: Written; in speech use 昨天.

ex: 他冷笑了一声，没说话。
He sneered and said nothing.
听到这个回答，她冷笑着走开了。
Hearing the answer, she walked off with a sneer.
use: Shows contempt; common in stories.

m: **Get** the means **to**: be **able to**, so that.
ex: 有了大家的帮助，问题得以解决。
With everyone's help, the problem was solved.
通过这次活动，我们得以认识了很多朋友。
Through this event we got to know many friends.
use: Written; before a verb.

m: **Think** and **hold** thoughts together: **thinking**, a way of thought.
ex: 学数学可以锻炼思维。
Studying maths trains your thinking.
他的思维很快，总有新想法。
He thinks fast and always has new ideas.
use: 思维方式 "way of thinking".

ex: 多运动对身体有好处。
Exercising more is good for your body.
学外语的好处很多。
There are many benefits to learning a foreign language.
use: Pattern 对…有好处 "be good for". Opposite 坏处.

ex: 那天我们都很高兴。
We were all very happy that day.
你还记得我们第一次见面的那天吗？
Do you remember the day we first met?
use: Can follow a clause: 我来的那天 "the day I came".

m: Let it **fall** onto something **real**: to **put into practice**.
ex: 计划一定要落实。
The plan must be carried out.
这个问题已经落实到每个人身上了。
Responsibility for this has been assigned to each person.
use: Common in official language: 落实政策.

ex: 你为何不早说？
Why didn't you say so earlier?
他为何突然离开，没有人知道。
Nobody knows why he left so suddenly.
use: Written; in speech use 为什么.

ex: 让我思考一下再回答。
Let me think about it before I answer.
这个问题值得我们认真思考。
This question deserves serious thought.
use: Deeper than 想; 独立思考 "think independently".

m: **Attack** a **mountain pass**: to **tackle a key problem**.
ex: 科学家们正在攻关新技术。
Scientists are tackling a new technology.
这个难题大家一起攻关，终于解决了。
We all tackled this tough problem together and finally solved it.
use: Formal; 技术攻关 "tackle technical problems".

ex: 他们是一对老夫妻。
They're an old married couple.
夫妻之间应该互相理解。
Husband and wife should understand each other.
use: Measure word 对.

ex: 这个地区遭受了洪水。
This area was hit by floods.
公司今年遭受了很大的损失。
The company suffered heavy losses this year.
use: Only for bad things: 损失, 打击, 灾难.

m: What **teaching** and **training** leave behind: a **lesson**, to lecture.
ex: 这次失败给了我一个教训。
This failure taught me a lesson.
他被爸爸狠狠地教训了一顿。
His father gave him a good telling-off.
use: 吸取教训 "learn a lesson".

ex: 这里的气候适宜种茶。
The climate here is good for growing tea.
这部电影不适宜儿童观看。
This film isn't suitable for children.
use: Written; close to 合适 and 适合.

ex: 大夫，我发烧了。
Doctor, I have a fever.
王大夫在这家医院工作了三十年。
Dr Wang has worked at this hospital for thirty years.
use: Read dàifu for "doctor"; spoken and northern. 医生 is standard.

ex: 他向我们展示了他的画。
He showed us his paintings.
这个博物馆展示了很多古代文物。
This museum displays many ancient relics.
use: More formal than 给…看.

m: The **woods** of the **martial** world: the **martial arts world**.
ex: 他是武林高手。
He is a martial arts master.
小说里写了很多武林中的故事。
The novel tells many stories of the martial arts world.
use: From martial arts (wuxia) novels and films.

ex: 上海是中国的东方门户。
Shanghai is China's eastern gateway.
这个网站是学校的门户网站。
This website is the school's portal.
use: 门户网站 "web portal".

ex: 他说的话有三分道理。
There's some truth in what he says.
她笑了笑，脸上有三分得意。
She smiled, looking a little pleased with herself.
use: Often paired: 七分…三分…; 让三分 "give way a bit".

ex: 这个项目吸引了很多投资者。
This project attracted many investors.
投资者都很关心公司的未来。
Investors are all concerned about the company's future.
use: 者 makes "one who": 投资 + 者.

ex: 他突然来了，我很意外。
I was surprised when he turned up out of the blue.
出门在外，一定要小心，别发生意外。
When you're out, be careful so nothing happens to you.
use: 发生意外 "have an accident"; 意外地 "unexpectedly".

ex: 听到这个消息，他非常愤怒。
He was furious to hear the news.
人们对这种行为感到愤怒。
People are angered by this kind of behaviour.
use: Stronger and more formal than 生气.

ex: 南北方的饮食有很大差异。
Food in the north and south differs a lot.
我们之间的文化差异不太大。
The cultural differences between us aren't very big.
use: More formal than 区别; 文化差异 "cultural difference".

ex: 他住在山的深处。
He lives deep in the mountains.
在我内心深处，我还是很想她。
Deep in my heart, I still miss her.
use: 内心深处 "deep down".

m: **Raise** the **body**: to **get up**, to set off.
ex: 他起身向大家告别。
He stood up and said goodbye to everyone.
我们明天一早就起身去机场。
We'll set off for the airport first thing tomorrow.
use: Also "get out of bed"; 站起来 is plainer.

ex: 这个城镇不大，但很干净。
This town isn't big, but it's clean.
越来越多的农民搬到城镇里生活。
More and more farmers are moving to live in towns.
use: Covers cities and small towns: 城镇化 "urbanisation".

ex: 当局正在调查这件事。
The authorities are investigating the matter.
当地当局决定关闭这个工厂。
The local authorities decided to close the factory.
use: News word, often for foreign governments.

ex: 沙漠里很少下雨。
It rarely rains in the desert.
骆驼可以在沙漠里走很多天不喝水。
Camels can walk for days in the desert without drinking.
use: Measure word 片.

ex: 请提前十分钟到。
Please arrive ten minutes early.
因为下雨，比赛提前结束了。
Because of the rain, the match ended early.
use: Before a verb: 提前准备; opposite 推迟 "postpone".

m: **Yun** (an old state) and **sunny side**: **Yunyang**, a district of Shiyan in Hubei.
ex: 郧阳在湖北省十堰市。
Yunyang is in Shiyan, Hubei.
郧阳发现过很古老的人类化石。
Very ancient human fossils have been found in Yunyang.
use: Now 郧阳区; known for the Yunxian Man fossils.

ex: 妈妈紧紧地抱着孩子。
The mother held her child tightly.
他紧紧握住我的手，说了声谢谢。
He gripped my hand tightly and said thank you.
use: Before a verb, usually with 地: 紧紧地抓住.

ex: 青岛的啤酒很有名。
Qingdao beer is famous.
夏天很多人去青岛的海边玩。
In summer many people go to Qingdao's beaches.
use: Coastal city in Shandong Province.

ex: 我们要消灭这些害虫。
We must get rid of these pests.
人类已经消灭了好几种疾病。
Humans have wiped out several diseases.
use: Strong word for destroying completely.

ex: 我们明天下午见面吧。
Let's meet tomorrow afternoon.
好久没见面了，我们一起吃个饭吧。
We haven't seen each other for ages; let's have a meal together.
use: Separable and takes no object: 跟/和某人见面, not 见面某人.

m: **Discuss** and give an **opinion**: to **comment**, a comment.
ex: 大家都在网上评论这件事。
Everyone is commenting on this online.
这篇文章下面有很多评论。
There are many comments under this article.
use: Also "review, commentary": 新闻评论.

ex: 这家公司的经济效益很好。
This company has good economic returns.
新机器提高了工厂的效益。
The new machine improved the factory's performance.
use: Business word: 经济效益, 社会效益.

m: An **item** on the list at each **joint** of a show: a **programme**.
ex: 你喜欢看什么电视节目？
What TV programmes do you like?
晚会上有很多精彩的节目。
There were many great acts at the evening show.
use: Measure word 个 or 台.

m: **Bestow** and **give**: to **give** or entrust (a duty, a meaning).
ex: 法律赋予公民很多权利。
The law gives citizens many rights.
这个节日被赋予了新的意义。
This festival has been given a new meaning.
use: Formal; with 权利, 使命, 意义.

ex: 他懂得怎么照顾别人。
He knows how to look after others.
长大以后，我才懂得父母的辛苦。
Only after growing up did I understand how hard my parents worked.
use: Often about life lessons; 懂 alone is plainer.

ex: 我只不过是开个玩笑。
I was only joking.
他只不过比我大两岁，懂得却很多。
He's only two years older than me, but he knows a lot.
use: Plays something down; often ends with 而已 or 罢了.

ex: 救灾物资已经送到了。
The disaster relief supplies have arrived.
这些物资是给山区孩子的。
These supplies are for children in the mountains.
use: For goods in bulk: 生活物资, 救援物资.

ex: 正当我要出门，电话响了。
Just as I was about to go out, the phone rang.
正当大家着急的时候，他回来了。
Just when everyone was getting worried, he came back.
use: Read zhèngdāng; as zhèngdàng it means "legitimate".

ex: 她从香港搬到了内地。
She moved from Hong Kong to the mainland.
内地的很多城市发展得很快。
Many inland cities are developing quickly.
use: Used by Hong Kong and Macau for mainland China.

ex: 这个宫女在宫里生活了二十年。
This palace maid lived in the palace for twenty years.
电视剧里的宫女每天都很忙。
The palace maids in TV dramas are busy every day.
use: Historical.

ex: 我会尽量早点儿来。
I'll try to come as early as possible.
请尽量不要在房间里吸烟。
Please try not to smoke in the room.
use: Before a verb; close to 尽可能.

m: **Good fortune** **established**: **Fujian**, a province on the southeast coast.
ex: 福建在台湾的对面。
Fujian is across the strait from Taiwan.
福建人很喜欢喝乌龙茶。
People in Fujian love oolong tea.
use: Short name 闽.

ex: 她在大学学习戏剧。
She studies drama at university.
这个城市每年都有戏剧节。
This city holds a theatre festival every year.
use: General term; 戏 alone is spoken, often Chinese opera.

ex: 车在路口转向了左边。
The car turned left at the junction.
他把注意力转向了学习。
He turned his attention to his studies.
use: Also figurative: switch focus or stance.

m: A word for the sound of "toast": **sliced bread**; also, in history, a local chieftain who took **charge** of the **earth**.
ex: 早饭我吃了两片土司。
I had two slices of toast for breakfast.
古代湖北西部有很多土司。
In ancient times western Hubei had many native chieftains.
use: For bread, 吐司 is now more usual on the mainland; 土司 also means "tusi chieftain".

m: **Grandson**, **middle**, **mountain**: **Sun Yat-sen**, founding father of the Republic of China.
ex: 孙中山是中国革命的先行者。
Sun Yat-sen was a pioneer of the Chinese revolution.
南京有孙中山的中山陵。
Nanjing has Sun Yat-sen's mausoleum.
use: Many streets are named 中山路 after him.

ex: 我们需要改变一下策略。
We need to change our strategy a little.
这次比赛他们用了很好的策略。
They used a very good strategy in this match.
use: Close to 战略, which is bigger-scale.

ex: 下周有中期考试。
There's a midterm exam next week.
明朝中期，经济发展得很快。
In the mid-Ming period, the economy grew fast.
use: Compare 前期, 后期; 中期计划 "medium-term plan".

ex: 水在人的体内很重要。
Water is very important inside the human body.
这种药能帮助排出体内的毒素。
This medicine helps remove toxins from the body.
use: Opposite 体外 "outside the body".

ex: 请留下电话，以便我们联系你。
Please leave your number so we can contact you.
他每天早起，以便有时间锻炼。
He gets up early every day so that he has time to exercise.
use: Written; starts the second clause.

ex: 反正没事，我陪你去吧。
I'm free anyway, so I'll go with you.
你去不去都行，反正我要去。
Whether you go or not is up to you; I'm going anyway.
use: Spoken; gives a reason that holds whatever happens.

ex: 我们彼此很了解。
We know each other well.
朋友之间应该彼此帮助。
Friends should help each other.
use: Close to 互相; 彼此彼此 "same to you".

ex: 他急忙跑出了门。
He hurried out of the door.
听到孩子哭，妈妈急忙走了过去。
Hearing the baby cry, the mother hurried over.
use: For past actions in stories; 赶紧 can give orders.

ex: 他们夺取了这座城市。
They captured the city.
我们队在比赛中夺取了冠军。
Our team won the championship.
use: Formal; 夺取胜利 "win victory".

ex: 今年要进行人口普查。
A population census will be carried out this year.
这次普查发现了很多新问题。
This general survey found many new problems.
use: 人口普查 "population census".

ex: 老师引导学生自己思考。
The teacher guides students to think for themselves.
工作人员引导游客排队进入。
Staff guided the visitors to queue up and enter.
use: Close to 指导; 引导 is gentler leading.

m: **Initiate** and **run**: to **found** a school or business.
ex: 他二十岁就创办了自己的公司。
He founded his own company at twenty.
这所学校是一九零五年创办的。
This school was founded in 1905.
use: For schools, companies, magazines.

ex: 警察在河边发现了一具尸体。
The police found a body by the river.
医生检查了尸体，确定了死亡时间。
The doctor examined the body and determined the time of death.
use: Measure word 具.

ex: 麋鹿是中国特有的动物。
The milu is an animal native to China.
我们在保护区看到了很多麋鹿。
We saw many Père David's deer in the nature reserve.
use: Also called 四不像 "like none of the four".

ex: 他是教育局的局长。
He is the head of the education bureau.
局长明天要来检查工作。
The bureau chief is coming to inspect our work tomorrow.
use: Measure word 位.

m: **Shine** on and **look after**: to **take care of**.
ex: 她在家照顾生病的妈妈。
She's at home taking care of her sick mother.
谢谢你这几天对我的照顾。
Thank you for looking after me these past few days.
use: Also a noun: 你的照顾 "your care".

ex: 他暗暗下了决心。
He quietly made up his mind.
看到她的成绩，我暗暗为她高兴。
Seeing her results, I was secretly happy for her.
use: Written; before a verb.

m: The **model** and **manner** of a person: their **look**.
ex: 她长得很像她妈妈年轻时的模样。
She looks just like her mother did when young.
十年没见，他还是老模样。
After ten years, he still looks the same.
use: Spoken; close to 样子.

m: The **taste** in your **mouth**: **taste**, preference in food.
ex: 这道菜很合我的口味。
This dish is just to my taste.
南方人和北方人的口味不太一样。
Southerners and northerners have rather different tastes.
use: Also "flavour": 草莓口味 "strawberry flavour".

m: The **gate** in the **city wall**: a **city gate**.
ex: 古代的城门晚上要关上。
In ancient times the city gates were closed at night.
西安的城门现在还保留得很好。
Xi'an's city gates are still well preserved.
use: Measure word 座.

ex: 具体安排如下。
The detailed arrangements are as follows.
考试的要求如下，请大家仔细看。
The exam requirements are as follows; please read carefully.
use: Written, introduces a list.

m: The **war** to **resist** **Japan** (the **sun**): the **War of Resistance against Japan**, 1937–1945.
ex: 抗日战争一共打了八年。
The War of Resistance against Japan lasted eight years.
爷爷经常给我讲抗日战争的故事。
Grandpa often tells me stories of the War of Resistance.
use: Shortened to 抗战.

ex: 这无疑是一个好主意。
This is undoubtedly a good idea.
他无疑是我们班最聪明的学生。
He is without doubt the cleverest student in our class.
use: Written; 毫无疑问 is a stronger form.

ex: 客人们陆续到了。
The guests arrived one after another.
学生们陆续走进了教室。
The students came into the classroom one by one.
use: Often 陆陆续续 in speech.

m: **Thorny shrub** and **gate**: **Jingmen**, a city in Hubei.
ex: 荆门在湖北省中部。
Jingmen is in central Hubei.
荆门有很多古代的墓。
Jingmen has many ancient tombs.
use: Prefecture-level city.

ex: 我有一个妹妹。
I have a younger sister.
妹妹比我小三岁，今年上大学。
My sister is three years younger than me and starts university this year.
use: Older sister is 姐姐.

ex: 这片林区不能生火。
No fires may be lit in this forest area.
他在东北的林区工作了很多年。
He worked in the forests of the northeast for many years.
use: Measure word 片.
